<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_include">
    <sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE">
        <access>package_private</access>
        <active>true</active>
        <api_name>sn_pw.ProjectWorkspaceFetchApi</api_name>
        <caller_access/>
        <client_callable>false</client_callable>
        <description/>
        <mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable>
        <name>ProjectWorkspaceFetchApi</name>
        <sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable>
        <script><![CDATA[var ProjectWorkspaceFetchApi = Class.create();
ProjectWorkspaceFetchApi.prototype = {
    initialize: function() {
        this.isSecure = ProjectWorkspaceUtil.getProperty('sn_pw.fetchData.isSecure', 'false');
		this.createTaskFunc = this.createTask();
		this.avatharApi = new Avathar();
		this.hideTimeComponent = false;
		this.resourceAssigneesMap = new Map();
		this.taskWithNotifications = new Map();
		this.shadowToOriginalTasks = new Map();
		this.softProjectIndicator = {
            type: 'icon',
            icon: 'tree-view-short-fill',
            tooltip: gs.getMessage('Soft Dependency')
        };
    },

    getTasksData: function(topTaskId, table, columns, taskIds) {
        if (!taskIds)
            return [];
        var query = 'sys_idIN' + taskIds;
        return this.getTasks(topTaskId, columns, table, query);
    },
	
	getSubProjectQueryAndDependencies: function(table, sysId, gr){
		var query = "";
		var outsideTasks = [], dependencies = [], gd;

		if (!table)
          table = 'planned_task';
		
		var topTaskId = gr.getValue("top_task");
		if(sysId != topTaskId){
			var wbs = gr.getValue("wbs");
			var oLinkQuery = "child.ref_planned_task.top_task=" + topTaskId + "^parent.ref_planned_task.top_task="+ topTaskId 
							+ "^child.ref_planned_task.wbs="+ wbs +"^ORchild.ref_planned_task.wbsSTARTSWITH"+ wbs
							+ "^ORparent.ref_planned_task.wbs="+ wbs +"^ORparent.ref_planned_task.wbsSTARTSWITH" + wbs;
			var grRel = new GlideRecord('planned_task_rel_planned_task');
			grRel.addEncodedQuery(oLinkQuery, true);
			grRel.query();
			while(grRel.next()){
				outsideTasks.push(grRel.getValue('parent'));
				outsideTasks.push(grRel.getValue('child'));
				
				dependencies.push(this._getDependencey(grRel));
			}
			
			query = "top_task="+topTaskId +"^wbsSTARTSWITH"+ wbs+".^ORwbs="+wbs + "^ORDERBYlevel^ORDERBYwbs_order^ORDERBYwbs^ORsys_idIN"+ outsideTasks.join();
		}
		
		return {
			query: query,
			dependencies: dependencies
		};
	},
	
	// Returns array of parentProjects except top task
	getParentProjects: function(subProjectId, ptasks, columns, baseTableStateUtil, beginingOfToday) {
		var parentProject,
			parentSubProjectGrs = [];
		
		parentSubProjectGrs = this._getParentProjectGr(subProjectId, parentSubProjectGrs);
		for( var i =0; i < parentSubProjectGrs.length; i++) {
			parentProject = this.createTaskFunc(parentSubProjectGrs[i], columns, baseTableStateUtil, beginingOfToday, {});
			if(parentProject.id == subProjectId)
				parentProject.isSummary = true;//this filed is used to give the summary task record behaviour to the sub project record in sub project view
			ptasks.push(parentProject);  // fetching all parent projects of subProjectId
		}
		return ptasks;
	},
	
	_getParentProjectGr: function(subProjectId, parentProjects) {
		var projectGr = new GlideRecord('pm_project');
		projectGr.get(subProjectId);
		if(projectGr.isValidRecord() && projectGr.getValue('parent')){
			parentProjects = this._getParentProjectGr(projectGr.getValue('parent'), parentProjects);
			parentProjects.push(projectGr);
		}
		return parentProjects;
	},
	
    getTasks: function(topTaskId, columns, table, query, firstRow, subProjectId) {

        var ptasks = [],
            indexTaskMap = {},
			batchSize = ProjectWorkspaceUtil.getFetchTasksBachSize(),
            childTable, childGr, temp;
		
		if(!columns) {
			columns = gs.getSession().getClientData('project_workspace_columns');
			columns = JSON.parse(columns);
		}
		
		if(subProjectId && !query)
			query = gs.getSession().getClientData(subProjectId + '_query');
		
		var beginingOfToday = this._getBeginingOfToday();
		var baseTableStateUtil = new global.PlannedTaskStateUtil(new GlideRecord(table));
		this._fetchNotificationsInfo(topTaskId);

        if (!table)
            table = 'planned_task';
		
		
		if (!firstRow) {
            var topTaskGr = new GlideRecord(table);
            topTaskGr.get(topTaskId);
            if (topTaskGr.isValidRecord()) {
				this.hideTimeComponent = topTaskGr.getValue('project_schedule_date_format') == 'date';
				temp = this.createTaskFunc(topTaskGr, columns, baseTableStateUtil, beginingOfToday, {});
				temp['execution_type'] = topTaskGr.getValue("execution_type");
				ptasks.push(temp); // top project should be first always
			} else
                return ptasks;
			
			if(subProjectId)
				ptasks = this.getParentProjects(subProjectId, ptasks, columns, baseTableStateUtil, beginingOfToday);
        }
		
		var childSubProjects = this.getSubProjects(topTaskId, columns, table, baseTableStateUtil, beginingOfToday, subProjectId);

        childTable = global.PTGlobalAPI.getProjectTaskTable(table);
        var childTableStateUtil = new global.PlannedTaskStateUtil(new GlideRecord(childTable));

        childGr = this._getGlideRecord(childTable, this.isSecure);
        if (query) {
			childGr.addEncodedQuery(query, true);
			/**
			 * chooseWindow is not working when encoded query has `sys_idIN`
			 * this case observed when retriving the saved tasks and it's getting called from getTasksData function
			 */
			if(!query.startsWith('sys_idIN'))
				childGr.chooseWindow(firstRow, firstRow + batchSize,true);
		} else {
            childGr.addQuery('top_task', topTaskId);
			childGr.addQuery('sys_class_name','!=','pm_project_task_link');
			childGr.orderBy('level');
            childGr.orderBy('wbs_order');
			childGr.orderBy('wbs');
			childGr.chooseWindow(firstRow, firstRow + batchSize,true);
        }
        childGr.query();
		
		var subProjectIndex = 0, subProject, subProjectLevel, subProjectWbsOrder, taskLevel, taskWbsOrder;
        while (childGr.next()) {
            temp = this.createTaskFunc(childGr, columns, childTableStateUtil, beginingOfToday, {});
			taskLevel = parseInt(temp.level.value);
			taskWbsOrder = parseInt(temp.wbs_order.value);

            subProject = childSubProjects[subProjectIndex];
			if(subProject) {
				subProjectLevel = parseInt(subProject.level.value);
				subProjectWbsOrder = parseInt(subProject.wbs_order.value);
			}
			
			while(subProject && (subProjectLevel < taskLevel || (subProjectLevel == taskLevel && subProjectWbsOrder < taskWbsOrder))) {
				ptasks.push(subProject);
				subProjectIndex++;
				subProject = childSubProjects[subProjectIndex];
				if(subProject) {
					subProjectLevel = parseInt(subProject.level.value);
					subProjectWbsOrder = parseInt(subProject.wbs_order.value);
				}
			}
			
            indexTaskMap[temp['wbs_order'].value] = ptasks.length; // finding the last index where a task of that wbs_order has been inserted
            ptasks.push(temp);
        }
		
		for( ; subProjectIndex < childSubProjects.length; subProjectIndex++) {
			ptasks.push(childSubProjects[subProjectIndex]);
		}
        return ptasks;
    },

    getSubProjects: function(topTaskId, columns, table, stateUtil, beginingOfToday, subProjectId ) {
        var subProjects = [],
            parentGr, temp;
		
		if(subProjectId) {
			var subProjectGr = new GlideRecord(table);
			subProjectGr.get(subProjectId);
			var subProjectWBS = subProjectGr.getValue('wbs');
		}
        parentGr = this._getGlideRecord(table, this.isSecure);
        parentGr.addQuery('top_task', topTaskId);
        parentGr.addQuery('sys_id', '!=', topTaskId);
		if(subProjectId){
			parentGr.addQuery('sys_id', '!=', subProjectId);
			parentGr.addQuery('wbs', 'STARTSWITH', subProjectWBS);
		}
		parentGr.orderBy('level');
        parentGr.orderBy('wbs_order');
		parentGr.orderBy('wbs');
        parentGr.query();
        while (parentGr.next()) {
            temp = this.createTaskFunc(parentGr, columns, stateUtil, beginingOfToday, {});
			temp['execution_type'] = parentGr.getValue("execution_type");
            subProjects.push(temp);
        }
		return subProjects;
    },
	
    getBaselinesInfo: function(topTaskId, tableName, selectedBaseline) {
        var baselineList = [], selectedFlag = false, baselineId;
        var userSelectedBaselineIds = ProjectWorkspaceUtil.getUserPreference(tableName+'_selected_baselines_'+topTaskId);
		var baselineGr1 = this._getGlideRecord('planned_task_baseline', 'true');
		baselineGr1.addQuery('top_task', topTaskId);
		baselineGr1.addQuery('enable_task_baseline', true);
		baselineGr1.orderByDesc("updated");
		baselineGr1.query();
		while (baselineGr1.next()) {
			baselineId =  baselineGr1.getValue('sys_id');
			selectedFlag = selectedBaseline ? (selectedBaseline == baselineId) : ((userSelectedBaselineIds && userSelectedBaselineIds.indexOf(baselineId) != -1) ? true : false);
			baselineList.push({
				id: baselineId,
				name: baselineGr1.getValue('name'),
				description: baselineGr1.getValue('description'),
				selected: selectedFlag
			});
		}
        return baselineList;
    },

	createTask() {
		const loadWithPermissions = ProjectWorkspaceUtil.getProperty('sn_pw.load_data_with_permissions', 'true');
		return loadWithPermissions === 'true' ? this.createTaskObjectWithPermissions : this.createTaskObject;
	},

    createTaskObjectWithPermissions(gr, columns, stateUtil, beginingOfToday, taskObj) {
		taskObj['canDelete'] = gr.canDelete();
		taskObj['canWrite'] = gr.canWrite();

		return this.createTaskObject(gr, columns, stateUtil, beginingOfToday, taskObj);
	},

    createTaskObject: function(gr, columns, stateUtil, beginingOfToday, taskObj) {
        let gd, dateValue;
		
        taskObj['id'] = gr.getValue('sys_id');
        taskObj['parent'] = gr.getValue('parent');
        if (gr.getValue('key_milestone') == '1' || gr.getValue('milestone') == '1')
            taskObj['type'] = 'milestone';
        for (var i = 0; i < columns.length; i++) {

			if(!columns[i].internalColumnName) 
				continue;
			
            if (columns[i].isExtendedColumn) {
                taskObj[columns[i].name] = {
                    value: gr.getElement(columns[i].internalColumnName).toString(),
                    displayValue: gr.getDisplayValue(columns[i].internalColumnName)
                };
            } else if (columns[i].type == 'date') {
                gd = new GlideDate();
                dateValue = gr.getDisplayValue(columns[i].internalColumnName);
                if (dateValue)
                    gd.setDisplayValue(dateValue);
                taskObj[columns[i].name] = {
                    value: dateValue ? ProjectWorkspaceUtil.convertToStandardISOFormat(gd.getDisplayValueInternal() + ' 00:00:00') : '',
                    displayValue: dateValue ? gd.getDisplayValue() : ''
                };
            } else if (columns[i].type == 'date_time') {
                dateValue = gr.getDisplayValue(columns[i].internalColumnName);
                if (dateValue) {
                    gd = new GlideDateTime();
                    gd.setDisplayValue(dateValue);
                }
                taskObj[columns[i].name] = {
                    value: dateValue ? ProjectWorkspaceUtil.convertToStandardISOFormat(gd.getDisplayValueInternal()) : '',
                    displayValue: dateValue ? gd.getDisplayValue() : ''
                };
				if (this.hideTimeComponent) {
					const dateTimeVal = taskObj[columns[i].name].value;
					if(dateTimeVal) {
						const dateGd = new GlideDateTime(dateTimeVal).getDate();
						taskObj[columns[i].name].displayValue = dateGd.getDisplayValue();
					}
				}
            } else if (columns[i].internalColumnName == 'duration' || columns[i].internalColumnName == 'work_duration' || columns[i].internalColumnName == 'effort' || columns[i].internalColumnName == 'work_effort') {
                gd = new GlideDuration();
                gd.setValue(gr.getValue(columns[i].internalColumnName));
				var durVal = gd.getDurationValue();
				if(global.JSUtil.notNil(durVal)) {
					durVal = durVal.substring(0, durVal.length - 3);
					var dayPart = gd.getDayPart();
					if(dayPart <= 0)
						durVal = '00 ' + durVal;
				}
				
                taskObj[columns[i].name] = {
                    value: durVal,
                    displayValue: gd.getDisplayValue()
                };
            } else if (columns[i].name == 'assigned_to') {
                var value = gr.getValue(columns[i].internalColumnName) || "";
                taskObj[columns[i].name] = {
                    value: value,
                    displayValue: gr.getDisplayValue(columns[i].internalColumnName),
					isChanged: false,
                    imageSrc: this.avatharApi.get(value)
                };
            } else {
                taskObj[columns[i].name] = {
                    value: gr.getValue(columns[i].internalColumnName) || "",
                    displayValue: gr.getDisplayValue(columns[i].internalColumnName)
                };
            }

			if (columns[i].type == 'avatar_group') {
                var listValue = gr.getValue(columns[i].internalColumnName) || "";
                var disValue = gr.getDisplayValue(columns[i].internalColumnName);
                disValue = disValue && disValue.split(",");
                listValue = listValue && listValue.split(",");
                var userObjList = [];
                for (var k = 0; k < listValue.length; k++) {
                    var userObj = {
                        value: (listValue[k]).trim(),
                        displayValue: (disValue[k]).trim(),
                        imageSrc: this.avatharApi.get(listValue[k])
                    };
                    userObjList.push(userObj);
                }
                taskObj[columns[i].name] = userObjList;
            } else if (columns[i].internalColumnName == ProjectWorkspaceConstants.RESOURCE_ASSIGNEE_LIST) {
                var resourceAssigneesObjList = [];
                var userResourceIds = gr.getValue(ProjectWorkspaceConstants.RESOURCE_ASSIGNEE) ;
				var groupResourceIds = gr.getValue(ProjectWorkspaceConstants.GROUP_RESOURCE_ASSIGNEE);
				if(groupResourceIds && groupResourceIds.length > 0){
					this._fetchResourceAssigneesObjList(groupResourceIds, 'sys_user_group',  gr.getValue('sys_id'), resourceAssigneesObjList);
				}	
				if(userResourceIds && userResourceIds.length > 0){
					this._fetchResourceAssigneesObjList(userResourceIds, 'sys_user',  gr.getValue('sys_id'), resourceAssigneesObjList);
				}	

                taskObj[columns[i].name] = resourceAssigneesObjList;
            }
        }

		var taskDecorator = new ProjectWorkspaceTaskDecorator();
        taskDecorator.populateGanttStartAndEndDates(gr, taskObj, stateUtil);
		taskDecorator.decorateTaskOverdue(gr, taskObj, beginingOfToday);
		
		taskObj['isExternal'] = gr.getValue('shadow') == '1' ? true : false;
		if(taskObj['isExternal']) {
			taskDecorator.populateExternalTaskProps(gr, taskObj);
			const originalTaskId = gr.getValue('orig_sys_id');
			this.shadowToOriginalTasks[gr.getValue('sys_id')] = originalTaskId;
			if(this.taskWithNotifications[originalTaskId]) {
				taskObj['isSoftDependentTask'] = true;
				taskObj['indicator'] = this.softProjectIndicator;
			}
		}

        return taskObj;
    },

	_fetchNotificationsInfo : function(topTaskId) {
		const notificationGr = new GlideRecord('planned_task_notification');
		notificationGr.addQuery('task_top_task', topTaskId);
		notificationGr.addQuery('state', 'new');
		notificationGr.query();
		while(notificationGr.next()){
			const key = notificationGr.getValue('source')+ '_' + notificationGr.getValue('task');
			this.taskWithNotifications[key] = true;
			this.taskWithNotifications[notificationGr.getValue('source')] = true;
		}
	},

	_fetchResourceAssigneesObjList : function(resourceIds, resourceTableName, taskId, resourceAssigneesObjList) {
		var resourceIdsArr = resourceIds.split(',');
		resourceIdsArr = this._checkInResourceMap(resourceIdsArr, resourceAssigneesObjList);
		const resourceObjList =  ProjectWorkspaceUtil.getUserOrGroupRecords(resourceIdsArr, resourceTableName, this.resourceAssigneesMap);
		resourceAssigneesObjList.push(...resourceObjList);
	},

	_checkInResourceMap: function(resourceIdsArr, resourceAssigneesObjList) {
		return resourceIdsArr.filter((resourceId) => {
				if(this.resourceAssigneesMap.has(resourceId))
					resourceAssigneesObjList.push(this.resourceAssigneesMap.get(resourceId));
				else
					return true;	
		});
	},


    getDependencies: function(topTaskId) {
        var dependencies = [],
            gd;
        var gr = new GlideRecord('planned_task_rel_planned_task');
        gr.addQuery('child.ref_planned_task.top_task', topTaskId);
        gr.addQuery('parent.ref_planned_task.top_task', topTaskId);
        gr.query();
        while (gr.next()) {
            dependencies.push(this._getDependencey(gr));
        }

        return dependencies;
    },
	
	_getDependencey: function(gr) {
		var dependencey = {};
		dependencey['id'] = gr.getValue('sys_id');
		dependencey['source'] = gr.getValue('parent');
		dependencey['target'] = gr.getValue('child');
		dependencey['type'] = gr.getValue('sub_type');
		const origSourceTask = this.shadowToOriginalTasks[gr.getValue('parent')];
		dependencey['depType'] =  gr.getValue('process_flag') == false && this.taskWithNotifications[origSourceTask+'_'+gr.getValue('child')] ? 'soft' : 'hard';

		var gd = new GlideDuration();
		gd.setValue(gr.getValue('lag'));
		dependencey['lag'] = gd.getDayPart();
		
		var isExternal = gr.getValue('orig_sys_id') ? true : false;
		dependencey['isExternal'] = isExternal;

		return dependencey;
	},
	
    getBaselineItems: function(baselineIds, topTaskId, table){
		if(!baselineIds){
			return [];
		}
		var hideTimeComponent = this._isTimeComponentHidden(topTaskId, table) || false;
		var baselineItem = new GlideRecordSecure('planned_task_baseline_item');
		baselineItem.addQuery('baseline', 'IN', baselineIds);
		baselineItem.query();
		var result = [];
		while(baselineItem.next()){
			result.push({
				id: baselineItem.getValue('baseline'),   //Which is used to map with baselineInfo before rendering to get proper color
				startDate: this._getBaselineDateInISOFormat(baselineItem.getDisplayValue('start'), hideTimeComponent),
				endDate: this._getBaselineDateInISOFormat(baselineItem.getDisplayValue('end'), hideTimeComponent),
				taskId: baselineItem.getValue('task')
			});
		}
		return result;
	},
	
	_isTimeComponentHidden: function(sysId, table) {
		if(!table)
			table = 'pm_project';
		var gr = new GlideRecord(table);
		gr.get(sysId);
		if(gr.isValidRecord()){
			return gr.getValue('project_schedule_date_format') == 'date';
		}
	},
	
	//Returns object with value and displayValue, where value is in StandardISOFormat
	_getBaselineDateInISOFormat : function(dateValue, hideTimeComponent) {
		if(dateValue) {
			var gd = new GlideDateTime();
			gd.setDisplayValue(dateValue);
			return {
				value: ProjectWorkspaceUtil.convertToStandardISOFormat(gd.getDisplayValueInternal()),
				displayValue: hideTimeComponent ? gd.getDisplayValue().split(' ')[0] : gd.getDisplayValue()
			};
		}
		return {
			value: '',
			displayValue: ''
		};
	},

    _getGlideRecord: function(table, isSecure) {
        var glideRecord;
        if (isSecure == 'true')
            glideRecord = new GlideRecordSecure(table);
        else
            glideRecord = new GlideRecord(table);
        return glideRecord;
    },
	
	_getBeginingOfToday: function() {
		var currentDate = new GlideDate();
		var beginingOfToday = new GlideDateTime();
		beginingOfToday.setDisplayValueInternal(currentDate.getDisplayValueInternal() + " " + "00:00:00");
		return beginingOfToday;
	},

    type: 'ProjectWorkspaceFetchApi'
};]]></script>
